people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: “A Redeemer will come to Zion, and to those who turn from disobedience in Jacob,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: “The Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who turn from transgression,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: And a Redeemer will come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith Jehovah.
